mods.name: Splatoon+
mods.author: Delus1on_L
mods.description:
A content update for Splatoon, made in the style of the game's original updates.

Includes:
- 50 new pieces of gear (safe to use online on Pretendo)
- New stage: Mako Parking Lot
- New font with extra Japanese, Alterna and icon characters
- New lobby UI and design
- New environments for Walleye Warehouse and Mahi-Mahi Resort
- Improved Octolings

The new stages must stay in Private Battles, or you can be banned from Pretendo. Back up your save with SaveMii first.

Source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/570597
requirements: Rival Unpatch plugin (do not use its Player.pack; this mod includes its own)

mods.name: The Splatlands Project
mods.author: Claygolor
mods.description:
Brings the Splatlands from Splatoon 3 to Splatoon.

Includes:
- Inkopolis Plaza replaced with Splatsville
- Murch in the city
- Splatsville ambience sounds
- Inkopolis News music replaced with the Anarchy Splatcast
- Splatoon 3 lobby over the Shooting Range
- Ports of Splatoon 3 stages

May conflict with other big mods such as Splatoon+.

Source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/599610

mods.name: Splatoon 2 Map Ports
mods.author: YoshiCrystal
mods.description:
High-quality ports of Splatoon 2 stages, including The Reef, Humpback Pump Track, Inkblot Academy, Musselforge Fitness, Starfish Mainstage, Sturgeon Shipyard, Manta Maria, Wahoo World, Goby Arena, Snapper Canal, Mako Mart and Shifty Station layouts.

The maps replace existing stages. Online play needs NoHash, and the maps must be unlocked or forced. Use at your own risk online.

Source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/356380

mods.name: Playable Rival Octoling
mods.author: Mannta
mods.description:
Gives Inklings the look of the rival Octolings (the unused Octoling form from the Splatoon 2 Testfire). This is the "Girl and Boy" version, which changes both genders.

Source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/288292

mods.name: Splatoon 2 DLC Octoling Ports
mods.author: kalomaze
mods.description:
Replaces the Inklings with the Octolings from the Splatoon 2 Octo Expansion. Both boys and girls become Octolings, since there's no boy Octoling.

To get the Octoling hair, wear the Sporty Bobble Hat (boy) or the Bobble Hat (girl).

Source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/250472
